name: Can I replace my existing bathtub with a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my existing bathtub with a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing an existing bathtub with a walk-in shower is a very common remodeling project. This transformation often creates a more open and modern bathroom space, while also improving accessibility. It typically involves removing the tub, modifying the plumbing for a shower drain, and then building the new shower pan and walls. Considerations include the size of the existing space and your desired shower dimensions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it is a common renovation to replace a bathtub with a walk-in shower, enhancing space and accessibility.
